title: Necromantic Magic
description: If you aren't a Wizard, you can **Cast a Spell**+int by combining a verb and a substance from the **Necromancy** (substance: unlife; verbs: briefly bestow; radiate) School of Magic. At the start of each session you get Aether equal to your int. For more details, see the Wizard Starting Move, **Weave the Arcane**.

outcomes.text: If you're a Wizard, add the substance **life** and the following verbs to your repertoire:

submoves.description: When you kill someone with a spell, they rise as a corporeal undead (ghoul, skeleton, zombie) under your command (3 HP, inflicts 1 dmg).

title: A Ghost at the Feast
description: You can spend 1 Aether to see into the Ethereal Dimension, where ghosts and spirits reside. When you kill someone with a spell, they can rise as an incorporeal undead instead, such as a ghost, shade, or shadow (1 HP, inflicts 2 dmg **piercing** | **invisible** **immaterial**).

title: Consume Unlife
description: Spend 1 Aether to sacrifice one or more of the undead under your command to recover HP equal to their current HP.

title: Undead Horde
description: You have raised a group of undead (starts at 5, up to 10) with the following tags: **hungry** **mindless** **slow** **undead**. They have HP and inflict dmg equal to their number.

outcomes.text: When you **command your undead horde**, spend 1 Aether and roll+cha.
They follow your orders to the best of their ability.
They get into trouble or you lose one of them (your call).
Someone's coming for you; mark 1 XP and the GM makes a Move.

title: The Creature
description: When you **Perform a Ritual** **to stitch a creature together from several corpses**, IT'S ALIVE! Roll+requirements fulfilled (1-4).

bullets: They're strong (double their HP and get **adv** on dmg rolls)

outcomes.text: Only one, and the GM adds a detail.
They escape with your name and a grudge.

submoves.description: The Creature has 6 HP and inflicts 1d8 dmg.
